edition.title: Cum per similes apostolicas literas — Provincia metropolitica Quebecensis erigitur et ei sedes Marianopolitana, Kingstoniensis et Torontina suffraganeae assignantur — Rome: Ex Typographia Polyglotta S. C. de Propaganda Fide, 1902.

work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Apostolic letter CCLXXXVIII erects the ecclesiastical province of Quebec with Montreal, Kingston and Toronto as suffragans and directs the bishops of Charlottetown, New Brunswick and Halifax to attend its provincial council; intitulation, narrative, erection, non obstantibus clause and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF51802–51802; the source dating clause at LF51860–51863 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima secunda iulii millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo quarto, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo quarto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
